evidence.reason: In the symlink branch, path.stat() follows the link, and when the target is not a regular file the code simply continues. That silently omits a symlinked drop-in directory such as backup.service.d even though systemd resolves it and reads drop-ins beneath it. The dependency scan can therefore miss a Wants=crq-tick.service edge and let discovery report complete/supported without observing the dependency. The no-follow policy can remain; the minimal corrective behavior is to return an incomplete/unsupported observation for a symlinked directory the scan refuses to traverse.
